rules.statement: An arbitration award must be formally prepared and signed by the arbitrator in accordance with the law.
rules.supporting_quote: The so called award, viz, the document containing the settlement dated 18.11.1998 tendered for enforcement was not in conformity with the law. A formal award on agreed terms should have been prepared and signed by the arbitrator in terms of sections 14 (3) and 25 (1) of the Arbitration Act and a copy thereof should have been delivered to the respondents as required by section 25 (4) of the Act. The mere recording of the agreement was not enforceable in terms of section 31 of the Act

rules.statement: A copy of the Arbitration Act must be delivered to the respondents in accordance with section 25.
